d: Emirates Investment Authority is the UAE Federal Government’s sovereign wealth fund, investing across diversified asset classes and global markets to create long-term value and support the UAE economy. Working across a broad investment portfolio, the organization is focused on safeguarding its interests through strong governance, sound oversight, and disciplined risk management.

As Compliance Manager, you will play an important role in strengthening the compliance environment around a diversified portfolio spanning passive investments in international funds and strategic assets. This role is suited to a compliance professional who brings strong judgment, a global regulatory perspective, and the ability to work across complex investment structures while supporting the organization’s long-term objectives.
q: Bachelor’s degree in law, finance, business, or a related field; a Master’s degree in law, finance, business, or a related field is a plus.
8+ years of experience in compliance within a sovereign wealth fund, investment company, or regulatory agency.
Deep expertise in U.S. and EU fund compliance regulations, AML/KYC requirements, sanctions regulations, and regulatory requirements in the Cayman Islands.
Familiarity with regulatory practices governing private and publicly listed assets in the UAE.

Ability to build and maintain compliance frameworks for portfolio companies and investment activities, and to design and maintain compliance policies, standards, procedures, and investment compliance checklists.

Experience conducting investment compliance due diligence, including review of investment guidelines and side letter obligations, as well as periodic compliance risk assessments and corrective actions.

Ability to lead incident investigations and reporting related to compliance and sanctions risks, present compliance reports, risks, and mitigation actions to senior management and board-level stakeholders, and deliver compliance training to internal teams, board members, and portfolio companies.

Proven ability to work closely with legal, risk, strategic assets, and investment teams on compliance matters, and to support the development and implementation of automated compliance monitoring solutions; ICA or CAMS certification is a bonus.
r: Oversee the compliance framework for a diversified investment portfolio, including passive investments in international funds and strategic assets in the UAE.
Ensure adherence to international best practices and applicable U.S., EU, and UAE regulations.
Protect the organization’s interests, mitigate compliance and investment risk exposure, and conduct rigorous due diligence on each investment opportunity.

d: Job Title: Senior Premium Reconciliation Specialist
Work Arrangement: 100% Remote — Work From Home

We are seeking an experienced Senior Premium Reconciliation Specialist to oversee remote insurance premium reconciliation, financial data analysis, transaction matching, and account discrepancy resolution. The role focuses on reviewing premium records, reconciling policy and payment information, investigating variances, and supporting accurate financial reporting across insurance operations.

The successful candidate will have strong knowledge of insurance premium accounting, financial reconciliation, policy administration, payment processing, and internal financial controls. Working remotely, the specialist will collaborate with finance teams, underwriting departments, brokers, insurers, policy administration teams, and authorized banking or payment personnel to maintain accurate and transparent premium records.

This is a fully remote position. Physical cash handling, original financial document custody, in-person banking activities, and any local payment or statutory processes must be performed by appropriately authorized local personnel.
Review and reconcile insurance premium records against policy schedules, invoices, endorsements, statements, and payment transactions.
Match premium collections, refunds, adjustments, commissions, and outstanding balances across approved financial and policy administration systems.
Investigate reconciliation differences, duplicate entries, unidentified receipts, underpayments, overpayments, and timing variances.
Verify premium calculations against approved policy terms, rates, endorsements, taxes, fees, and applicable adjustments.
Monitor premium receivables, outstanding balances, aging reports, and settlement status.
Reconcile broker statements, insurer accounts, intermediary balances, and internal premium control accounts.
Review supporting documentation for premium adjustments, cancellations, policy amendments, and refund requests.
Coordinate with underwriting, claims, finance, brokerage, and policy administration teams to resolve discrepancies.
Prepare reconciliation schedules, variance reports, exception logs, and management summaries.
Support month-end and year-end closing activities through accurate premium balance reviews and account reconciliations.
Identify recurring process weaknesses and recommend improvements to reconciliation workflows and financial controls.
Review transaction records and audit trails to support financial accuracy, accountability, and compliance.
Assist with internal and external audit requests by preparing supporting schedules and relevant documentation.
Maintain organized digital records and ensure confidentiality of policyholder, broker, and financial information.
Monitor reconciliation performance indicators and support continuous improvement of premium accounting processes.
Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Insurance, or a related discipline.
Significant experience in insurance premium accounting, financial reconciliation, insurance operations, or accounts management.
Strong understanding of insurance premium calculations, policy transactions, endorsements, cancellations, refunds, and commission structures.
Experience reconciling premium statements, broker accounts, payment records, receivables, and financial ledger balances.
Familiarity with accounting principles, general ledger processes, month-end reconciliation, and financial control procedures.
Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and experience with accounting systems, enterprise resource planning (ERP) platforms, or insurance management systems.
Ability to analyze large transaction datasets, investigate variances, and identify discrepancies accurately.
Understanding of insurance documentation, financial governance, and applicable regulatory requirements.
Strong numerical, analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
Excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to coordinate with multiple departments.
High standards of accuracy, confidentiality, integrity, and attention to detail.
Ability to work independently in a fully remote environment and meet reporting deadlines.
100% remote working arrangement, with no routine office attendance required.
Full-time professional opportunity in insurance finance and premium accounting.
Opportunity to contribute to financial accuracy, reconciliation quality, and operational efficiency.
Collaboration with experienced finance, underwriting, insurance operations, and brokerage professionals.
Exposure to insurance accounting systems, financial reporting processes, and premium management activities.
Professional development opportunities in insurance finance, reconciliation controls, and financial operations.

Interested candidates should submit an updated CV highlighting relevant insurance premium reconciliation experience, accounting knowledge, financial systems proficiency, and experience resolving complex transaction discrepancies.
Application Subject: Application – Senior Premium Reconciliation Specialist (UAE Remote)

Candidates should confirm applicable employment arrangements, residency requirements, and work authorization before accepting an offer. Binding financial approvals, premium adjustments, refund authorizations, payment releases, regulated accounting certifications, tax determinations, regulatory submissions, and statutory sign-offs must be completed by appropriately licensed, delegated, or authorized finance and insurance professionals in accordance with applicable regulations and organizational controls.
